This stage works the menu of defensible analyses, one decision at a time, and ends on the one analysis that you would defend, declared in the preregistration block of your report before it runs and then run again on the data of the replication in the SCORE replicability study. It takes about six hours.

## 1. The specification menu

[Open the specification menu](../../menu.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the menu.

## 2. The menu and the methods

**On the slides**, in Part 4, from the menu onwards. The `d` key shows and hides an optional run of slides on the methods.

## 3. Task 4 – The menu

**In your report**, in the chunks of Task 4 of `index.qmd`, or in your working script. Try the reference specification and three or four others, changing one argument at a time. If you want your exploration on the [class chart](../../class-results.qmd), send the try that you would defend with `submit_exploration()`, and it appears there as an open circle.

[Open the deck at Task 4](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-4-work-the-menu){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## 4. Multiverse and preregistration

**On the slides**, from [your own small multiverse](../../live/day.html#/you-just-built-a-small-multiverse){target="_blank"} onwards.

## 5. Task 5 – Preregistration

**In the preregistration block of your report**, the chunk `prereg` of `index.qmd`. Complete the block before you run anything. Render the report and keep the rendered copy, which carries the date on which it was rendered. Then fit the specification with `run_spec()`, and send it with `report_result()` if you want it on the chart, where it appears as a filled circle.

[Open the deck at Task 5](../../live/day.html#/the-preregistration-moment){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 5](../../lab.qmd#task-5-preregistration){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If your installation fails, complete the block in the deck or in the browser lab, and copy the completed cell into your notes instead of rendering.

## 6. Task 6 – Replication

**In your report**, in the chunks of Task 6 of `index.qmd`, or in your working script. Run `replicate_spec(my_spec)`, which translates your declared specification to the new experiment and fits it on its data, then draw the figure and write the two sentences that the task asks for. Then follow the slides from [the replication](../../live/day.html#/the-score-replication){target="_blank"} to the end of Part 4.

[Open the deck at Task 6](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-6-replication){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 6](../../lab.qmd#task-6-replication){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## 11. The case-study report {#the-case-report}

**In your workspace.** Render the report of the workspace with all six tasks complete, the preregistration block as it stood before the run and the result beneath it. This is your case-study report. The section "Going further" at its end holds optional exercises that run in the workspace.

**Sending results.** Both submissions are optional. A result sent alone joins the class chart of the case study beside the results that earlier cohorts sent. The workspace draws a tag of its own for the chart, and the browser lab draws one that lasts only for the browser session, so to find your marks again, give the same nickname every time, as in `submit_exploration(nickname = "blue-heron")`.

**Shortcuts.** If time is short, read only the section on [robustness and replicability](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-replicability) of the multiverse module now, and come back to the rest of it when your project in stage 5 needs it.
